annotations.title: Record a bank transfer against a payment request

description: Record that a payment request's client already paid OUTSIDE gocushy (a bank transfer, typically). This is bookkeeping with teeth: it books revenue, issues the sequentially numbered tax invoice, emails the client their receipt, and files to Xero/QuickBooks — and an issued invoice is a record that can only be corrected by a recorded refund, never deleted. CONFIRM WITH THE MERCHANT FIRST: restate the request, the amount and the received date, and only call after they say yes. received_at is the date the money actually landed (never the future); pass the statement reference if they have it. Refused (422) when the request is not open, when the account is not on a paying plan, or when the feature is off.

received_at.description: ISO date the money landed in the merchant's account — becomes the order's paid_at

reference.description: The bank statement reference, if the merchant has it
